subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu support a documented per-account inbound file/media suppression option for model context, or should OpenClaw reject/clarify the unsupported `ignoreFileContent` key and keep current media attachment behavior?
rationale: The reported key is not part of the current Feishu config contract, and adding it would create a new user-facing config surface with attachment and context semantics.

options.title: Add documented opt-out
options.body: Add a Feishu-owned top-level/per-account setting that skips inbound file downloads for agent context and sends only a safe placeholder or filename metadata.

options.title: Clarify unsupported config
options.body: Keep current inbound media behavior, document `mediaMaxMb` as the supported control, and make doctor/config validation explain that `ignoreFileContent` is not supported.

options.title: Design a shared channel policy
options.body: Pause Feishu-specific work and define a cross-channel inbound media suppression contract if maintainers expect the same behavior for other transports.

recommendation.title: Add documented opt-out
recommendation.body: Add a Feishu-owned top-level/per-account setting that skips inbound file downloads for agent context and sends only a safe placeholder or filename metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is Feishu-specific and the package metadata identifies @m1heng as the community owner boundary for the plugin.
